author: "Andrea Chen"
date: "`r Sys.Date()`"
output: pdf_document

# parameters for plotting
```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# parameters for plotting
dataset_name <- "fluc_env"
date <- "8_4"

# set these once for your machine / project
analysis_root <- "figure/1_26_fluctuating_env"
base_plot_folder     <- file.path("figure/plots", date)
r_data_folder    <- file.path("figure", "r_data", dataset_name)

library(MetBrewer)

if (!dir.exists(base_plot_folder)) {
  dir.create(base_plot_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
}

met_brewer_pallete <- "Austria"  # color pattern for lines
```

# load genotype data
```{r}
fluc_geno_df <- readRDS(file.path(r_data_folder, "genotype.rds"))
fluc_pheno_df <- readRDS(file.path(r_data_folder, "phenotype.rds"))
# group_tag_df <- readRDS(file.path(r_data_folder, "group_tag.rds"))

# copied_val_df <- readRDS(file.path(r_data_folder, "copied_val.rds"))
# fluc_pheno_df <- readRDS(file.path(r_data_folder, "phenotype.rds"))
```

# parameter space for data
```{r}
psi_val <- c(0.46)
single_psi <- 0.2

colors_for_psi <- met.brewer(name=met_brewer_pallete, n=4, type="discrete")
psi_col_map <- setNames(colors_for_psi, c(0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8))

for (gen in list(10050)) {
  for (n in c(8)){
    for (sz in c(40, 90)){ 
      for (gap in c(80, 30)){
        for (reg in c("fit")){
          for (type in c( "genotype", "phenotype")){
            cat("Plotting:", type, " generation:", gen, " n:", n, " shift_size:", sz, " reg:", reg, "\n")
      
            breaks_vec <- seq(-20.5, 40.5, by = 1)  
            if (type == "genotype"){
              df_to_use <- fluc_geno_df
            } else if (type == "phenotype"){
              df_to_use <- fluc_pheno_df
            } else if (type == "copied_val"){
              df_to_use <- copied_val_df
            } else if (type == "geno_pheno_diff"){
              df_to_use <- diff_df
            }

            if (length(gen) > 1 ){
              gen_title <- paste0(gen[1], "-", gen[2])
            }else{
              gen_title <- gen
            }

            title <- paste0(type, "_", gen_title, "/", reg, "_", sz,"_", n)

            # if (is.integer(sz)){
              filt_A <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.0, shift_size=sz, gap=gap)
              filt_B <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.2, shift_size=sz, gap=gap)
              filt_C <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.5, shift_size=sz, gap=gap)
              filt_D <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.8, shift_size=sz, gap=gap)

              filt_single <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=single_psi, shift_size=sz, gap=gap)
            # }else{
            #   filt_A <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.0, gap=gap)
            #   filt_B <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.2, gap=gap)
            #   filt_C <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.5, gap=gap)
            #   filt_D <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.8, gap=gap)

            #   filt_single <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=single_psi, gap=gap)
            # }

            fils <- list(filt_A, filt_B, filt_C, filt_D)
            # fils <- list(filt_single)
            if (length(fils) == 1){
              plot_folder = file.path(base_plot_folder, paste0("fluc_", type, "_", gen_title, "_", single_psi))
            }else{
              plot_folder = file.path(base_plot_folder, paste0("fluc_", type, "_", gen_title))
            }

            dir.create(plot_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
            pdf(file.path(plot_folder, paste0(reg, "_sz_", sz,"_n_", n,"_gap_", gap, ".pdf")), width=11.5, height=8)
            
            par(cex.axis = 2.0, cex.lab = 2.0, cex.main = 1.0, mar = c(6, 6, 3, 1) + 0.2, mgp = c(3.8, 1.5, 0))
            cols <- psi_col_map[as.character(sapply(fils, function(f) f$psi))]
            plot_hist_lines_multi(
              df = df_to_use,
              # filters = list(filt_A, filt_B, filt_C),
              filters = fils,
              generation = gen,
              breaks = breaks_vec,
              labels = list(title = title,
                            x = ifelse(type == "genotype", "Genotype value", "Phenotype value"),
                            y = "Proportion"),
              show_rep = TRUE,
              ymax = if (type == "genotype") 0.06 else 0.1,
              cols = cols,
              lwd = 5
            )
            leg_expr <- as.expression(lapply(lapply(fils, function(f) f$psi), function(v) bquote(psi == .(v))))
                  
            legend("topright", bty = "n",
                    legend = leg_expr,
                  col = cols, lwd = 2, cex=2.2)
            dev.off()
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}
```

```{r}
psi_val <- c(0.46)
single_psi <- 0.5
gen <- c(10000, 10010, 10020, 10030, 10050, 10070, 10080)

colors_for_psi <- met.brewer(name=met_brewer_pallete, n=4, type="discrete")
psi_col_map <- setNames(colors_for_psi, c(0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8))

for (n in c(8)){
  for (shift_size in c(100)){
    for (gap in c(50)){
      for (reg in c("fit")){
        for (type in c( "phenotype")){
          cat("Plotting:", type, " generation:", gen, " n:", n, " shift_size:", shift_size, " reg:", reg, "\n")
    
          breaks_vec <- seq(-20.5, 40.5, by = 1)  
          if (type == "genotype"){
            df_to_use <- fluc_geno_df
          } else if (type == "phenotype"){
            df_to_use <- fluc_pheno_df
          } else if (type == "copied_val"){
            df_to_use <- copied_val_df
          } else if (type == "geno_pheno_diff"){
            df_to_use <- diff_df
          }

          if (length(gen) > 1 ){
            gen_title <- paste0(gen[1], "-", gen[[length(gen)]])
          }else{
            gen_title <- gen
          }

          if(gen_title >= 10000){
            title <- paste0(type, "_", gen_title, "/", reg, "_", shift_size,"_", n, "opt = ", shift_size)
          }else{
            title <- paste0(type, "_", gen_title, "/", reg, "_", shift_size,"_", n, "opt = ", 0)
          }

          if (is.integer(shift_size)){
            filt_A <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.0, shift_size=shift_size, gap=gap)
            filt_B <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.2, shift_size=shift_size, gap=gap)
            filt_C <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.5, shift_size=shift_size, gap=gap)
            filt_D <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.8, shift_size=shift_size, gap=gap)

            filt_single <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=single_psi, shift_size=shift_size, gap=gap)
          }else{
            filt_A <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.0, gap=gap)
            filt_B <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.2, gap=gap)
            filt_C <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.5, gap=gap)
            filt_D <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=0.8, gap=gap)

            filt_single <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=single_psi, gap=gap)
          }

          # fils <- list(filt_A, filt_B, filt_C, filt_D)
          fils <- list(filt_single)
          if (length(fils) == 1){
            plot_folder = file.path(base_plot_folder, paste0(type, "_", gen_title, "_", single_psi, "_multigen"))
          }else{
            plot_folder = file.path(base_plot_folder, paste0(type, "_", gen_title, "_multigen"))
          }

          dir.create(plot_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
          pdf(file.path(plot_folder, paste0(reg, "_sz_", shift_size,"_n_", n,"_gap_", gap, ".pdf")), width=11.5, height=8)
          
          par(cex.axis = 2.0, cex.lab = 2.0, cex.main = 1.0, mar = c(6, 6, 3, 1) + 0.2, mgp = c(3.8, 1.5, 0))
          # cols <- hcl.colors(4, hcl_color_palette)
          cols <- psi_col_map[as.character(sapply(fils, function(f) f$psi))]
          # cols <- c(cols[1], cols[2], cols[3])
          plot_hist_lines_multi_gen(
            df = df_to_use,
            filters = fils,
            generations = gen,
            breaks = breaks_vec,
            labels = list(
              title = paste0(type, " distribution across generations"),
              x = if (type == "genotype") "Genotype value"  else "Phenotype value",
              y = "Proportion"
            ),
            show_generation = TRUE,
            generation_alpha = c(0.2, 1),
            plot_mean = FALSE,
            show_rep = FALSE,
            cols = cols,
          )
          leg_expr <- as.expression(lapply(lapply(fils, function(f) f$psi), function(v) bquote(psi == .(v))))
                
          legend("topright", bty = "n",
                  legend = leg_expr,
                col = cols, lwd = 2, cex=2.2)
          dev.off()
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

```

```{r}
single_psi <- 0.8

colors_for_psi <- met.brewer(name=met_brewer_pallete, n=4, type="discrete")
psi_col_map <- setNames(colors_for_psi, c(0.0, 0.2, 0.5, 0.8))

# gen <- c(seq(9900, 9995, by=5), seq(9996, 10009, by=1), seq(10010, 10300, by=5))
# gen <- seq(9950, 10300, by=5)

zlim <- c(0, 0.15)
grey_color_palette <- colorRampPalette(c("#FFFFFF", "#000000"))(64)

for (single_psi in c(0.8)){
  for (n in c(8)){
    for (sz in c(40, 90)){ 
      for (gap in c(30)){
        for (reg in c("fit", "ext", "ave")){
          if (single_psi == 0.0 && reg != "fit"){
            next
          }
          gen <- seq(10000, 10210, by=5)
          
          breaks_vec <- seq(as.integer(-sz/2)-10.5, as.integer(sz/2)+10.5, by = 1)  
          if (sz == 10){
            breaks_vec <- seq(-20.5, 20.5, by = 1)
          }
          gen_title <- paste0(gen[1], "-", gen[length(gen)])
          
          title <- paste0( "pheno_geno_dict_", gen_title, "/", reg, "_", sz,"_", n, "opt = ", 0)
          
          filt_single <- list(reg=reg, n=n, psi=single_psi, shift_size=sz, gap=gap)
    
          plot_folder = file.path(base_plot_folder, paste0("fluc_pheno_geno_dict_", gen_title, "_", sz, "_", gap))
          
          dir.create(plot_folder, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings=FALSE)
          # pdf(file.path(plot_folder, paste0(reg, "_", sz,"_", n, ".pdf")), width=11.5, height=8)
          
          par(cex.axis = 2.0, cex.lab = 2.0, cex.main = 1.0, mar = c(6, 6, 3, 1) + 0.2, mgp = c(3.8, 1.5, 0))
          # cols <- psi_col_map[as.character(sapply(fils, function(f) f$psi))]

          if (gap == 80){
            gen_vals=c(
              seq(10000, 10050,     by = 5),
              seq(10050, 10050 + gap, by = 5),
              seq(10050 + gap, 10050 + 2 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10050 + 2 * gap, 10050 + 3 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10050 + 3 * gap, 10050 + 4 * gap, by = 5)
              # seq(10000 + 4 * gap, 10000 + 5 * gap, by = 5),
              # seq(10000 + 5 * gap, 10000 + 6 * gap, by = 5)
            )
            line_vals = c(
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10000, 10050, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10050, 10050 + gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10050 + gap, 10050 + 2 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10050 + 2 * gap, 10050 + 3 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10050 + 3 * gap, 10050 + 4 * gap, by = 5)))
              # rep(as.integer( sz / 2), length(seq(10000 + 3 * gap, 10000 + 4 * gap, by = 5)))
            )
          }else if (gap == 10){
            gen_vals=c(
              seq(10000,           10000 + gap,     by = 5),
              seq(10000 + gap,     10000 + 2 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10000 + 2 * gap, 10000 + 3 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10000 + 3 * gap, 10000 + 4 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10000 + 4 * gap, 10000 + 5 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10000 + 5 * gap, 10000 + 6 * gap, by = 5)
            )
            line_vals = c(
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10000,           10000 + gap,     by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer( sz / 2), length(seq(10000 + gap,     10000 + 2 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10000 + 2 * gap, 10000 + 3 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer( sz / 2), length(seq(10000 + 3 * gap, 10000 + 4 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10000 + 4 * gap, 10000 + 5 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer( sz / 2), length(seq(10000 + 3 * gap, 10000 + 4 * gap, by = 5)))
            )
          } else if (gap == 30){
            gen_vals=c(
              seq(10000, 10010,     by = 5),
              seq(10010, 10010 + gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + gap, 10010 + 2 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 2 * gap, 10010 + 3 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 3 * gap, 10010 + 4 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 4 * gap, 10010 + 5 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 5 * gap, 10010 + 6 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 6 * gap, 10010 + 7 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 7 * gap, 10010 + 8 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 8 * gap, 10010 + 9 * gap, by = 5),
              seq(10010 + 9 * gap, 10290, by = 5)
            )
            line_vals = c(
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10000, 10010, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10010,  10010 + gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + gap, 10010 + 2 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 2 * gap, 10010 + 3 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 3 * gap, 10010 + 4 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 4 * gap, 10010 + 5 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 5 * gap, 10010 + 6 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 6 * gap, 10010 + 7 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 7 * gap, 10010 + 8 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 8 * gap, 10010 + 9 * gap, by = 5))),
              rep(as.integer(-sz / 2), length(seq(10010 + 9 * gap, 10290, by = 5)))
            )
          }
          if (gap == 80){
              x_label_gens = seq(10050, 10290, by=gap)
              x_label_text = seq(0, 290, by=gap)
          } else if (gap == 10){
              x_label_gens = seq(10000, 10000 + gap * 4, by=2*gap)
              x_label_text = seq(0, 4 * gap, by=2*gap)
          } else if (gap == 30){
              x_label_gens = seq(10050, 10290, by=80)
              x_label_text = seq(0, 290, by=80)
          }
          plot_pheno_geno_heatmaps(
            cons_pheno_df = fluc_pheno_df,
            cons_geno_df = fluc_geno_df,
            breaks = breaks_vec,
            pheno_filter = filt_single,
            geno_filter = filt_single,
            pheno_generations = gen,
            geno_generations = gen,
            # pheno_zlim = pheno_zlim,
            # geno_zlim = geno_zlim,
            zlim = zlim,
            file = file.path(plot_folder, paste0(reg, "_",  n, "_", sz,"_", gap, "_", single_psi, ".pdf")),
            x_label_gens = x_label_gens,
            x_label_text = x_label_text,
            zero_col = NULL,
            color_palette = grey_color_palette,
            gen_vals=gen_vals,
            line_vals = line_vals,
            show_mean_line = TRUE,
          )
          # leg_expr <- as.expression(lapply(lapply(fils, function(f) f$psi), function(v) bquote(psi == .(v))))
                
          # legend("topright", bty = "n",
          #         legend = leg_expr,
          #       col = cols, lwd = 2, cex=2.2)
          dev.off()

        }
      }
    }
  }
}

)
```

```{r}
sort_cols <- c("n", "psi", "rep", "gap", "shift_size", "reg", "generation")

fluc_geno_df  <- fluc_geno_df[do.call(order, fluc_geno_df[sort_cols]), ]
fluc_pheno_df <- fluc_pheno_df[do.call(order, fluc_pheno_df[sort_cols]), ]

# check that metadata rows now match
stopifnot(identical(fluc_geno_df[sort_cols], fluc_pheno_df[sort_cols]))
```

```{r}
ind_cols <- grep("^[0-9]+$", names(fluc_geno_df), value = TRUE)

diff_df <- fluc_geno_df
diff_df[ind_cols] <- fluc_pheno_df[ind_cols] - fluc_geno_df[ind_cols]
```

## plot multi generation 
```{r}
breaks_vec <- seq(-40, 150, by = 1)                 # outside [-5,5] ignored
filt <- list(reg="inv", n=8, shift_size=120, beta=0.0)
gens <- c(9999, 10010, 10020, 10030, 10050, 10070, 10100)

col = grDevices::hcl.colors(3, "Dark 2", rev = TRUE)[3]

out_dir  <- file.path(base_plot_folder, "geno_multi")
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir, recursive = TRUE)
out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0( reg, "_geno.png"))

png(out_file, width=2200, height=1500, res=150)
par(cex.axis = 1.6, cex.lab = 2.0, cex.main = 1.0, mar = c(4.5, 6, 3, 1) + 0.1)

)
```

## pdf of the heatmaps 
```{r}

# ----------------- user-editable settings -----------------
ns    <- c(2, 8, 20, 50)
psis  <- c(0, 0.5, 0.9)
regs  <- c("ave", "fit", "ext")
types <- c("genotype", "phenotype")
szs   <- c(20, 40, 60)

xcol <- "generation"          # change to "tick" if needed
gap_col <- "fluctuate_gap"    # column name in your dfs

# If phenotype is NOT wide numeric columns, set this to its value column name, e.g. "z"
# If phenotype IS wide numeric columns too, leave NULL.
pheno_value_col <- NULL

plot_folder <- paste0(base_plot_folder, "heatmap_pdf/")
if (!dir.exists(plot_folder)) dir.create(plot_folder, recursive = TRUE)
# ============================ main PDF loop ================================
for (shift_size in szs) {

  pdf_file <- file.path(
    plot_folder,
    paste0("heatmap_grid_gap_", gap, "_sz_", shift_size, ".pdf")
  )

  pdf(pdf_file, width = 18, height = 10, onefile = TRUE)

  # breaks fixed within this shift_size
  breaks_vec <- seq(-1 * as.integer(shift_size) - 10, as.integer(shift_size) + 10, by = 1)

  for (type in types) {
    if (type == "genotype") df_to_use <- fluc_geno_df
    else if (type == "phenotype") df_to_use <- fluc_pheno_df
    else if (type == "fitness") df_to_use <- fitness_df

    # decide how to read values for this type
    mode <- if (!is.null(pheno_value_col)) "long_col" else "wide_numeric"
    vcol <- if (mode == "long_col") pheno_value_col else NULL

    for (reg in regs) {

      # ---- 1) build ALL heatmats for this page, and compute shared zlim ----
      hm_list <- vector("list", length(psis) * length(ns))
      names(hm_list) <- paste(rep(psis, each = length(ns)), rep(ns, times = length(psis)), sep = "_")

      max_vals <- c()
      idx <- 1
      for (p in psis) {
        for (n in ns) {
          filt <- list(
            reg = reg,
            psi = p,
            n = n,
            shift_size = shift_size
          )
          # include gap filter only if column exists
          if (gap_col %in% names(df_to_use)) filt[[gap_col]] <- gap

          hm <- .build_heatmat(
            df = df_to_use,
            filter = filt,
            xcol = xcol,
            breaks_vec = breaks_vec,
            mode = mode,
            value_col = vcol,
            z = "prop"
          )

          hm_list[[idx]] <- hm
          if (!is.null(hm)) max_vals <- c(max_vals, max(hm$mat, na.rm = TRUE))
          idx <- idx + 1
        }
      }

      zlim_page <- c(0, max(max_vals, na.rm = TRUE))
      if (!is.finite(zlim_page[2]) || zlim_page[2] <= 0) zlim_page <- c(0, 1e-6)

      # ---- 2) layout: 3 rows × (4 panels + 1 colorbar) ----
      lay <- matrix(1:12, nrow = 3, ncol = 4, byrow = TRUE)
      lay <- cbind(lay, 13)
      layout(lay, widths = c(rep(1, 4), 0.40))


      # page title space
      par(oma = c(0.5, 0.5, 2.0, 0.5))

      # panel styling (you can control par() outside normally, but for PDF pages this is convenient)
      par(
        mar = c(2.8, 3.0, 2.0, 0.5),
        mgp = c(1.8, 0.6, 0),
        cex.axis = 0.9,
        cex.lab  = 1.0,
        cex.main = 0.95
      )

      # ---- 3) draw panels row-major: psi rows, n columns ----
      idx <- 1
      for (p in psis) {
        for (n in ns) {
          hm <- hm_list[[idx]]

          panel_title <- paste0("n=", n, ", psi=", p)
          xlab <- if (p == psis[length(psis)]) "Generation" else ""
          ylab <- if (n == ns[1]) {
            if (type == "genotype") "Genotype" else "Phenotype"
          } else ""

          .plot_heat_panel(
            hm = hm,
            zlim = zlim_page,
            col = hcl.colors(100, hcl_color_palette),
            main = panel_title,
            xlab = xlab,
            ylab = ylab,
            axes = TRUE,
            box = TRUE
          )

          idx <- idx + 1
        }
      }

      # ---- 4) shared colorbar cell ----
      par(mar = c(2.8, 0.3, 2.0, 3.5), mgp = c(1.8, 0.6, 0))
      .draw_colorbar_panel(zlim_page, col = hcl.colors(100, hcl_color_palette), label = "Proportion")

      # ---- 5) page title ----
      mtext(
        paste0(
          "shift_size=", shift_size, ", gap=", gap,
          " | ", .reg_label(reg), " | ", type
        ),
        side = 3, outer = TRUE, line = 0.2, cex = 1.2
      )
    }
  }

  dev.off()
  cat("Wrote:", pdf_file, "\n")
}
```
